name: hud_ui_options_panel_resolution_sync_from_options
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_Resolution::SyncFromOptions maps the saved video mode and software/hardware acceleration option to the resolution cycle selector index and visible range.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40cd30 subtracts two from zVid::GetVideoModeIndexFromOptions, returns unchanged for unsigned cases above five, and then dispatches separate software and hardware tables using zVid::GetAccelerationOption.

The software table maps mode cases 0..5 to SetIndexClamped/SetVisibleRange pairs (3,2,4), (1,0,2), (2,2,4), (0,0,2), (4,4,5), and (5,5,6). The hardware table maps cases 0..3 to (3,3,4), (1,1,2), (2,2,3), and (0,0,1), while cases 4 and 5 share the software tail.

Native smoke zhud_options_panel_resolution_sync_from_options_smoke installs video-mode and acceleration option pointers, verifies the hardware mode-2 mapping, the software mode-2 mapping, the shared mode-7 mapping, and verifies an out-of-range mode leaves the selector state unchanged.
